name: Typography
description: Text components that use the font of the host app: Heading (H1 to H4) with the visual size separate from the semantic level, Text, Lead, Prose for raw HTML, InlineCode, Blockquote and List.

level.description: Heading only: the semantic level, 1 to 4. Pick the level that fits the page outline, not the look.

size.description: Visual size, independent of the level. Heading takes sm to 2xl; Text takes sm, md or lg (default md).

tone.description: Text colour. danger is for error text and must say what is wrong in words.

as.description: Text only: the element, a paragraph or an inline span.

children.description: The text, or for Prose the raw HTML elements to style.

requirements: Heading renders h1 to h4 from level, so the outline is set by level and never by size
Do not skip levels (h2 then h4)
Muted text keeps 4.5:1 against the surface; danger text is never the only sign of an error
Blockquote is a real blockquote element; a source goes in a footer or cite
List renders ul or ol with real list items
Links inside Prose keep an underline and a visible focus ring
screenReader: Headings are reachable by heading navigation with the right level
Lists are announced with their item count
Inline code is read as ordinary text

use_when: Article or CMS content that arrives as HTML (wrap it in Prose)
Body, helper and error text that must follow the design tokens
avoid_when: Labels for form fields: use the field's own label
Choosing a heading level for its size: change size instead
anti_patterns: Using H1 several times on a page
Picking h4 because it looks smaller
Using danger tone without a message
